```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

jq -c '
  [ .[] | select(.status == "paid") | {customer, value: ((([.items[]? | .qty * .price] | add) // 0))} ]
  | group_by(.customer)
  | map({customer: .[0].customer, orders: length, total: (map(.value) | add)})
  | sort_by([(0 - .total), .customer])
  | .[]
' /home/eval/data/orders.json > /home/eval/data/customers.jsonl

jq -r '
  [ .[] | select(.status == "paid") | .items[]? | {sku, qty} ]
  | group_by(.sku)
  | map({sku: .[0].sku, qty: (map(.qty) | add)})
  | sort_by([(0 - .qty), .sku])
  | .[0] // empty
  | "\(.sku) \(.qty)"
' /home/eval/data/orders.json > /home/eval/data/top_sku.txt

exit 0
```
